thread:
marco: Heads-up: scheduling a kernel ABI change to canary tonight 22:00 PT. This touches q8 kernels and will trigger new quant builds. Will post exact images and rollout plan shortly.

eva (eng-platform): Need the image tags so Dedicated pinning can be prepared. Also confirm traffic split plan.

marco: putting the commands here for ops copy/paste:

```
# schedule canary
deploybot schedule --env=canary --start=2026-03-22T22:00:00-07:00 \
  --img=redwood/runtime:kernel-abi-v2 --quant-tag=quant-v2 --route-policy=percent:10:2h
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by marco for canary starting 2026-03-22T22:00:00-07:00. ID: db-1799123456. Route policy: 10% initial, ramp 2h.

oliver (eng-ml): Does the new ABI break existing KV cache binary layout? We need to avoid cold-cache storms.

marco: Good question. There is a conversion shim that accepts old KV format and writes new layout lazily. Shim enabled only for canary. If we hit regressions we'll remove shim and rollback.

sophie (oncall): Provide a concise rollback playbook so oncall can act quickly if latency or errors spike.

marco: Rollback steps (short):
1) Abort rollout: `deploybot cancel db-1799123456`
2) Pin nodes back to stable: `kubectl set image ds/runtime redwood/runtime:kernel-abi-v1 -n inference`
3) Restart runtime: `kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime -n inference`
4) Revert route rule: `routectl set canary 0%`
5) Open incident if >5% error spike for >5m.

```
# rollback example
deploybot rollback --to-image redwood/runtime:kernel-abi-v1 --force
kubectl rollout status ds/runtime -n inference
```

release-bot: Release note draft created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/releases/kernel-abi-v2 (internal link)

eva (eng-platform): We'll prepare Dedicated pin config. File path: `ops/pins/kernel-abi-v2-dedicated.json` and we'll stage it but not apply until canary stable for 4h. Also request explicit 10% traffic cap.

marco: Confirmed: canary 10% initial, ramp to 30% over 2h if health checks pass. Fallback policy: any gateway 5xx OR P95 latency > 2x baseline -> immediate rollback.

oliver: Quant pipeline note: building q8 and q4 artifacts for kernel-abi-v2. Artifact bucket: s3://redwood-builds/quant/kernel-abi-v2/{q8,q4}/. I'll tag artifacts with `quant-v2-<sha>` and update model router mapping.

sophie (oncall): Night-change window acknowledged: 22:00-03:00 PT. Oncall rotation: sophie -> ryan -> tanya. I'll page if any of the following happen: error-rate >2% sustained, latency p95 >2s increase, or deploybot reports >30% failures during rollout.

marco: I'll add a short smoke test that hits warm paths and KV conversion. Command in CI: `make smoke-canary TEST_NAMESPACE=canary`.

deploy-bot: Canary started for db-1799123456 at 2026-03-22T22:00:00-07:00. Targets: runtime pods in `canary` pool. Healthchecks: running.

deploy-bot: Canary health: 5/5 probes passing, avg latency +3%. Traffic at 10%.

marco: Will monitor logs for conversion errors. If all good, we'll bump to 30% at 00:00 PT.

release-bot: Note added to changelog: "Kernel ABI v2: q8 kernel fixes, KV conversion shim, quant v2 artifacts." Link: https://changelogs.internal/redwood/kernel-abi-v2

eva (eng-platform): Quick ops note: make sure Dedicated uses pinned image; do NOT auto-upgrade during this window. I'm adding a hold to the upgrade pipeline.

oliver: If we see regressions in quality for quant-v2, we can fallback to quant-v1 artifacts with a model-router override: `model-router override --model=* --quant=quant-v1`

sophie (oncall): 00:12 PT update: canary stable for 2h, error rate normal. Requesting ramp to 30% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramping to 30% per policy for db-1799123456.

marco: Thanks everyone. Keep short updates here. If anything looks off, call it out with @sophie.

sophie: ack :thumbsup:
